name: Cedar Course Co. - Escalation (demo, not live)

parameters.content:
## Handoff to a person
Called by "Notify Team" in the support agent.

Slack is on by default. To use Telegram instead: disable "Post to Slack" and enable "Post to Telegram (optional)", then pick your Telegram credential and chat id.

If this posting fails, the Error Workflow (set in Workflow Settings) alerts you on a different channel.

meta.templateNote: Demo on made-up data. Not imported into or run on a live n8n instance and not connected to a live WhatsApp number. No credential is configured: every credential is a placeholder with id REPLACE_ME.
